note: Published rates, read on the date each row carries. Every figure is an estimate and is rendered as one. No row is attributed to a booking company: IRCTC, MakeMyTrip, OYO, Uber and Ola are where a family books, not where these numbers come from. Re-read the sources before a demo if these dates are stale.

rail_local.source: Suburban/passenger rail second-class fare, Mumbai division slab table (about Rs 10 for 25 km)

rail_sleeper.source: Indian Railways sleeper-class distance slabs, approximated to a per-km rate over 500-1500 km

rail_3ac.source: Indian Railways AC 3-tier distance slabs, approximated to a per-km rate over 500-1500 km

bus_state.source: State road transport ordinary-service per-km fare, typical across Maharashtra/Bihar/Jharkhand

bus_deluxe.source: State road transport semi-deluxe per-km fare, typical

auto.source: Metered auto-rickshaw rate, Mumbai gazetted tariff, including the minimum-fare effect on short hops

taxi.source: Metered black-and-yellow taxi rate, Mumbai gazetted tariff

dharamshala.source: Typical charitable-trust dharamshala contribution near a tertiary hospital; many ask only a donation

guest_house.source: Typical hospital or trust guest-house room near a tertiary hospital

hotel.source: Typical budget hotel room in a metro hospital district. A band for the kind of place, not any named hotel's price
